hints: The first stage represents the message method: text ($0.3$), email ($0.2$), and social media ($1 - 0.3 - 0.2 = 0.5$).
From each method branch, draw two second-stage branches: immediate reply ($R$) and no immediate reply ($N$).
Fill in the conditional probabilities: for text, $R = 0.4, N = 0.6$; for email, $R = 0.15, N = 0.85$; for social media, $R = 0.6, N = 0.4$.
walkthrough:
Determine the first-stage message probabilities:
$$\mathrm{P}(\text{Text}) = 0.3, \quad \mathrm{P}(\text{Email}) = 0.2, \quad \mathrm{P}(\text{Social Media}) = 1 - 0.3 - 0.2 = 0.5$$

Determine the conditional reply and no-reply probabilities for each method:
$$\begin{array}{lcl}
\text{From Text (T):} & \mathrm{P}(R \mid T) = 0.4, & \mathrm{P}(N \mid T) = 1 - 0.4 = 0.6 \\
\text{From Email (E):} & \mathrm{P}(R \mid E) = 0.15, & \mathrm{P}(N \mid E) = 1 - 0.15 = 0.85 \\
\text{From Social Media (S):} & \mathrm{P}(R \mid S) = 0.6, & \mathrm{P}(N \mid S) = 1 - 0.6 = 0.4
\end{array}$$
Draw the fully labelled tree diagram with all branches and probabilities clearly identified.
teacher_walkthrough: Megan communicates by three methods: Text ($T$), Email ($E$), or Social Media ($S$). We construct a complete two-stage tree diagram.

Step 1: First stage (method chosen):
- Text: $\mathrm{P}(T) = 0.3$
- Email: $\mathrm{P}(E) = 0.2$
- Social Media: $\mathrm{P}(S) = 1 - (0.3 + 0.2) = 0.5$
Notice that $0.3 + 0.2 + 0.5 = 1.0$.

Step 2: Second stage (reply outcome):
For each communication channel, there are two complementary outcomes: Immediate Reply ($R$) and No Immediate Reply ($N$).
- After Text branch:
  $$\mathrm{P}(R \mid T) = 0.4, \quad \mathrm{P}(N \mid T) = 1 - 0.4 = 0.6$$
- After Email branch:
  $$\mathrm{P}(R \mid E) = 0.15, \quad \mathrm{P}(N \mid E) = 1 - 0.15 = 0.85$$
- After Social Media branch:
  $$\mathrm{P}(R \mid S) = 0.6, \quad \mathrm{P}(N \mid S) = 1 - 0.6 = 0.4$$
Step 3: Clearly label all six terminal paths on the diagram.

hints: State the conditional probability definition: $\mathrm{P}(E \mid N) = \frac{\mathrm{P}(E \cap N)}{\mathrm{P}(N)}$.
Calculate the denominator $\mathrm{P}(N)$ by summing the no-reply probabilities across all three methods: $(0.3)(0.6) + (0.2)(0.85) + (0.5)(0.4)$.
Divide the numerator by the denominator and evaluate as an exact fraction or to 3 significant figures.
walkthrough:
State the formula for conditional probability:
$$\mathrm{P}(E \mid N) = \frac{\mathrm{P}(E \cap N)}{\mathrm{P}(N)}$$

Calculate the joint probability of email and no immediate reply:
$$\mathrm{P}(E \cap N) = 0.2 \times 0.85 = 0.17$$

Calculate the total probability of receiving no immediate reply $\mathrm{P}(N)$ across all three routes:
$$\mathrm{P}(N) = \mathrm{P}(T \cap N) + \mathrm{P}(E \cap N) + \mathrm{P}(S \cap N)$$
$$\mathrm{P}(N) = (0.3 \times 0.6) + (0.2 \times 0.85) + (0.5 \times 0.4) = 0.18 + 0.17 + 0.20 = 0.55$$
teacher_walkthrough: We need to find the probability that a message was sent by email ($E$), given that Megan received no immediate reply ($N$).

Step 1: State the definition of conditional probability:
$$\mathrm{P}(E \mid N) = \frac{\mathrm{P}(E \cap N)}{\mathrm{P}(N)}$$

Step 2: Compute the numerator $\mathrm{P}(E \cap N)$:
From the tree diagram, multiply the branch probabilities along the email and no-reply path:
$$\mathrm{P}(E \cap N) = 0.2 \times 0.85 = 0.17$$

Step 3: Compute the denominator $\mathrm{P}(N)$ using the Law of Total Probability:
A message can receive no immediate reply via any of the three communication channels:
- Via Text: $\mathrm{P}(T \cap N) = 0.3 \times 0.6 = 0.18$
- Via Email: $\mathrm{P}(E \cap N) = 0.2 \times 0.85 = 0.17$
- Via Social Media: $\mathrm{P}(S \cap N) = 0.5 \times 0.4 = 0.20$
Summing all three mutually exclusive possibilities:
$$\mathrm{P}(N) = 0.18 + 0.17 + 0.20 = 0.55$$

Step 4: Divide to obtain the conditional probability:
$$\mathrm{P}(E \mid N) = \frac{0.17}{0.55} = \frac{17}{55} \approx 0.309$$
